name: Arcane Tinkerer
summary: Arcane tinkerers use their knowledge and understanding of magic to disrupt or even destroy constructs
replacesText: 1st, 5th, and 11th-level Arcanist Exploits; optionally 7th and 13th-level Arcanist Exploits

features.name: Manipulate Construct (Su)

resourceActions.label: Manipulate Construct
resourceActions.summary: Spend 1 reservoir point to use the currently unlocked Manipulate Construct effect.

features.summary: An arcane tinkerer can turn the animating magic of a construct against itself. As a standard action, she can expend 1 point from her arcane reservoir to impose a –1 penalty on a single construct’s attack and damage rolls for 1 round. The target can attempt a Will save to negate this effect (DC = 10 + half the arcane tinkerer’s level + the arcane tinkerer’s Charisma modifier). At 7th level, instead of gaining an arcanist exploit, an arcane tinkerer can improve her manipulate construct ability to instead affect a construct with slow for 1 round. At 13th level, if the arcane tinkerer has previously improved this ability, instead of gaining an arcanist exploit, she can improve this ability again to instead cause a construct to become helpless for 1 round. This replaces the arcanist exploit gained at 1st level.

features.name: Arcanist Exploit or Improved Manipulate Construct
features.summary: Choose a normal arcanist exploit, or improve Manipulate Construct so it instead slows a construct for 1 round.

features.name: Break Magic Immunity (Su)
features.summary: At 5th level, an arcane tinkerer can overcome a construct’s immunity to magic. When targeting a construct with a spell, the construct is instead treated as if it has spell resistance equal to 15 + the construct’s CR. At 11th level, a construct is instead treated as if it has spell resistance equal to 11 + the construct’s CR. This replaces the arcanist exploits gained at 5th and 11th level.

features.name: Arcanist Exploit or Greater Manipulate Construct
features.summary: Choose a normal arcanist exploit, or, after taking the 7th-level improvement, make Manipulate Construct render its target helpless for 1 round.

mechanicalNotes: Manipulate Construct unlocks at 1st level; its reservoir cost and mutually exclusive exploit-or-improvement choices at 7th and 13th levels are automated. Saving throws, targets, and Break Magic Immunity remain descriptive.
